title: Representative continuity homology map
statement: For Abelian categories A and B with derived categories, a filtered diagram D of complexes in A with lower truncation a, a functor F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B, a diagram P of complexes in B with colimit, a complex L, isomorphisms e : D ⋙ Q ⋙ F ≅ P ⋙ Q and ε : F.obj (Q.obj (condensedContinuityCocone D a).pt) ≅ Q.obj L, and a cocone map ι satisfying the displayed leg equation, if every homology-level condensed continuity comparison for F is an isomorphism, then for every q the homology map of colimit.desc P (Cocone.mk L ι) is an isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), shifted or representative comparison step

proof.text: Whisker the given diagram isomorphism e with H^q and compose with homologyFunctorFactors. Combine the vertex isomorphism ε with the same factorization. Precompose both sides of the resulting comparison identity with every colimit inclusion. homologyFunctorFactors naturality and the supplied hι identify these legs. Hence colimMap(e_q.hom) ≫ colimit.post P H^q ≫ H^q.map(colimit.desc P (Cocone.mk L ι)) equals the assumed invertible continuity comparison composed with the invertible vertex factorization. The first factor is invertible because e_q is a natural isomorphism. The second factor is invertible because exact colimits commute with complex homology, by [src-weil-homology-preserves-exact-colimits]. Cancel these two factors to prove the requested homology map invertible. No geometric continuity theorem or hypercover result is used.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 5.3(1), formal comparison compatibility; D4 uses generic shift and exact-colimit APIs

lean.statement:
theorem condensedContinuityComparison_representatives_homology
    {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    {B : Type u} [Category.{z} B] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{z} B]
    {I : Type x} [Category.{y} I] [IsFiltered I]
    [HasColimitsOfShape I B] [HasExactColimitsOfShape I B]
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    [HasColimit (D ⋙ (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE a).truncGEFunctor A)]
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    [∀ q : ℤ, HasColimit (D ⋙ (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor B q))]
    (h : ∀ q : ℤ, IsIso (condensedContinuityComparison D a
      (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor B q)))
    (P : I ⥤ CochainComplex B ℤ) [HasColimit P] (L : CochainComplex B ℤ)
    (e : D ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ≅ P ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (ε : F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (condensedContinuityCocone D a).pt) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)
    (ι : P ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj L)
    (hι : ∀ i : I, e.hom.app i ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (ι.app i) =
      F.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((condensedContinuityCocone D a).ι.app i)) ≫ ε.hom) :
    ∀ q : ℤ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (colimit.desc P (Cocone.mk L ι)) q)
